newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 opens through 4,400 at six-week high.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 opens through 4,400 at six-week high.

text.p: UK shares pushed higher at the start of trading, taking their lead from the latest advance on Wall Street and with the FTSE 100 index rising through the 4,400 resistance level to its highest level in six weeks.
The blue chip index was up 13.2 points at 4,402.9 by 0740 GMT, its highest since March 17, with gaining stocks outweighing decliners by some five to one.

Banks once again led the advance, with shares squeezed higher as investment funds flooded into the sector to increase weighting in anticipation of the entry into the FTSE 100 of Halifax and other former building societies.
